Providing your herd or flock with the most quality feed.
Our Services For You!
The Feed Mill operations of Farmers Co-Op Elevator is located in Vriesland, Michigan. Our feed consultants will assist you in your feed management program offering a wide variety of services and programs.
Grinding, mixing, and delivery services
Grain drying
Grain bank
Complete Feeds
Liquid and dry supplements
Full feed analysis
Corn & Ingredient booking
For more information, please contact our feed mill at (616) 772-2515 .
